text:
Maria: Heads-up — onboarding new org 'novafold' for research. Need cross-cloud accounts (AWS us-west-2, GCP us-west1, eu-west1). Primary asks: GPU quotas (A100/H100), VPC & subnet sizing, IAM roles, billing project + tags. Anyone have a concise checklist we should run before opening support cases?

Jon: Quick checklist I use: 1) create org/account/project skeleton + billing linkage; 2) standard tag set; 3) IAM roles/template (infra/ops/sre/dev); 4) reserve subnets + secondary ranges for pods; 5) estimate GPU counts by region and request quotas; 6) create support cases with exact SKUs and zones.

Samir: For quotas — request per-region and include both instance and GPU-type quotas. Example bodies: 
GCP (submit quota request via console):
```json
{
  "project": "novafold-billing",
  "region": "us-west1",
  "quotas": [
    {"metric": "A100_40GB_GPUS", "limit": 8},
    {"metric": "H100_GPUS", "limit": 4},
    {"metric": "CPUS", "limit": 200}
  ]
}
```
AWS (support case):
```text
We need EC2 G4dn/G5/G5g/A100/H100 capacity in us-west-2: target 8 x p4d / 4 x p5 instances. Please increase service quotas: 'Running On-Demand G4dn instances', 'Running On-Demand P4d instances' etc. Zones: us-west-2a/us-west-2b. This is for research cluster, contact: maria@redwood.com.
```
Include expected steady and burst counts + use-case to speed approvals.

Carol: Network notes — don't forget ENI and IP quotas on AWS and reserved internal IPs on GCP. Recommend: allocate a /20 VPC per environment (prod/staging/research) so nodes + pods have headroom. Add secondary CIDR for GKE/Pod ranges. NAT BW: request higher NAT Gateway throughput if you expect heavy egress. Also firewall: allow 22, 443, 10250 (kubelet), health-check ports.

Kevin: Tagging & billing: mandatory tags = [team, project, owner, env, cost-center]. Make billing export: GCP billing -> BigQuery dataset 'billing_novafold'; AWS -> Cost and Usage Report to S3 + Glue/Athena. For Dedicated/reserved capacity, we need a linked billing account and procurement PO asap.

infra-bot: auto: opened ticket INFRA-12345 for 'novafold onboarding' and scheduled quota-scan. Current quick-scan: AWS p4d quota = 0 in us-west-2, GCP A100 quota = 2 in us-west1. Recommend raising to requested amounts before cluster deploy.

Maria: Thanks — I'll open formal support cases today. Can someone own AWS side (support case + ENI checks)? @Samir?

Samir: I got AWS. Will draft case and paste here. Plan: request p4d & p5 quotas, ENI limit bump, and EC2 spot options.

Jon: I'll file GCP quota requests and set up the billing export. Linking internal template: https://intranet/redwood/onboarding-templates (use the 'research org' variant).

Carol: I'll handle VPC/subnet sizing and firewall rules. Note for pods: reserve a /22 for worker secondary ranges if you plan to autoscale.

Kevin: I'll add the cost-center and owner tags to the billing project and loop in finance for PO.

Maria: Awesome — let's sync tomorrow 10am PT to confirm support case numbers and share IDs. :thumbsup:
